root_cause.text: `seg6_input_core()` and `rpl_input()` in the IPv6 lwtunnel path cached the result of `ip6_route_input()` while it was still a `NOREF` `dst_entry`, so `dst_cache_set_ip6()` could later `dst_hold()` a dead per-CPU route (`pcpu_rt`) after a PREEMPT_RT race freed it.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `skb_dst_force(skb)` immediately after `ip6_route_input(skb)` in both `net/ipv6/seg6_iptunnel.c` and `net/ipv6/rpl_iptunnel.c`, with comments stating “ip6_route_input() sets a NOREF dst; force a refcount on it before caching or further use,” and the CVE text explains that `dst_cache_set_ip6()` unconditionally calls `dst_hold()` on a `NOREF` dst, leading to use-after-free.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix rpl_input() to refcount the routed dst before use and reject packets when no valid route destination is returned.
intent_record.what: In rpl_input(), after calling ip6_route_input(skb) when no dst is present, the code now forces a reference on the returned skb dst with skb_dst_force(skb), then reloads dst from skb_dst(skb), and adds a new check that drops the packet with err = -ENETUNREACH if dst is still NULL before any caching or further use.
intent_record.how: This ensures the routing destination obtained by ip6_route_input() is safe to cache or dereference by taking a refcount on a NOREF dst, and it prevents later use of an absent destination by failing cleanly with network unreachable instead of proceeding unsafely.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix seg6 input routing to take a real reference on the route dst and fail cleanly if no destination is available.
intent_record.what: In `seg6_input_core()`, after calling `ip6_route_input(skb)` when `dst` is null, the code now forces a reference on the skb's destination with `skb_dst_force(skb)`, reloads `dst` from `skb_dst(skb)`, and adds a null check that sets `err = -ENETUNREACH` and jumps to `drop` if no destination is available.
intent_record.how: This ensures the route destination obtained by `ip6_route_input()` is refcounted before it is cached or otherwise used, preventing use of a NOREF dst without a held reference and avoiding unsafe access when no destination could be established.

grouping_result.intent: Fix seg6 input routing to take a real reference on the route dst and fail cleanly if no destination is available.
